title.en: PowerShell pipes objects, bash pipes text

concept.hr: Isti zadatak u dva cjevovoda: retci teksta naspram objekata sa svojstvima
concept.en: The same task in two pipelines: lines of text versus objects with properties

summary.hr: Korak po korak kroz isti zadatak u bashu i PowerShellu: što teče cijevi nakon svake naredbe, i gdje tekst zavara, a svojstvo ne.
summary.en: Step through the same task in bash and PowerShell: what flows through the pipe after each command, and where text misleads and a property does not.

title.hr: Razmak u imenu: awk ispisuje pola imena
title.en: A space in a name: awk prints half the name

concept.hr: Tekst se dijeli na razmacima, pa se polja pomaknu; svojstvo Name ostaje cijelo
concept.en: Text splits at the blanks, so the fields shift; the Name property stays whole

title.hr: Format-Table prije Sort-Object: tablica nije poredana
title.en: Format-Table before Sort-Object: the table is not sorted

concept.hr: Oblikovanje pretvara objekte u zapise za ispis, pa iza njega nema Length
concept.en: Formatting turns objects into display records; after it there is no Length
